approach: Static recompilation of MIPS R5900 code to C++20 with a PS2Recomp-based runtime (emulated IOP running the game's original IRX modules, VU0/VU1 microcode compiled ahead of time, IPU emulation) and PCSX2's hardware GS renderer (DX11) for drawing.
notes: Playable: menus, memory card saves, fights, story mode, FMVs, music and voices. Runs at 60 FPS in progressive scan, 8-fighter brawls included, at 1x to 8x internal resolution with PCSX2's filters and HD texture packs. Requires your own copy of the game.
